queries.postgres: INSERT INTO menuaccess (menuname, menucode, menutype, menuicon, sortorder, description, recordstatus, moduleid) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 1, (SELECT moduleid FROM module WHERE modulename = $7 LIMIT 1)) RETURNING menuaccessid
queries.sqlserver: INSERT INTO menuaccess (menuname, menucode, menutype, menuicon, sortorder, description, recordstatus, moduleid) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, (SELECT TOP 1 moduleid FROM module WHERE modulename = ?)); SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY();
queries.oracle: INSERT INTO menuaccess (menuname, menucode, menutype, menuicon, sortorder, description, recordstatus, moduleid) VALUES (:1, :2, :3, :4, :5, :6, 1, (SELECT moduleid FROM module WHERE modulename = :7 AND ROWNUM = 1)) RETURNING menuaccessid INTO :8
queries.sqlite: INSERT INTO menuaccess (menuname, menucode, menutype, menuicon, sortorder, description, recordstatus, moduleid) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, (SELECT moduleid FROM module WHERE modulename = ? LIMIT 1))
queries.mysql: INSERT INTO menuaccess (menuname, menucode, menutype, menuicon, sortorder, description, recordstatus, moduleid) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, (SELECT moduleid FROM module WHERE modulename = ? LIMIT 1))

list_queries.mysql: SELECT menuaccessid, menuname, menucode FROM menuaccess WHERE recordstatus = 1 ORDER BY menuname LIMIT 20
list_queries.sqlserver: SELECT TOP 20 menuaccessid, menuname, menucode FROM menuaccess WHERE recordstatus = 1 ORDER BY menuname
